name: web-cream-404-page-with-line-drawn-cat-hanging-from-the-zero-and-yarn
title: Cream 404 with dark thin numerals, a cat hanging through the zero, an orange yarn ball and a potted plant
whatItIs: A cream page with a thin nav and orange outlined Contact button, large dark line numerals '404' where an orange-and-white cat pokes through the zero, an orange ball of yarn with a trailing thread, an orange potted plant, a short line 'The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have been moved.' and an orange Back To Home pill.
whatItMeans: Warm and witty; the cat playing with yarn softens the dead end.
techniques: Let a character interact with the numerals.
Use clean line art with one orange accent.

vocabulary.definition: A figure interacting with the digits of 404.
A thin thread line leading from a ball.
A thin horizontal line that grounds a scene.
